evals.prompt: Add an internal changelog to our existing authenticated admin CMS. Keep it completely out of the public site and do not create developer release notes.
evals.expected_output: Creates validated CMS-only policy and structured history, verifies the existing auth guard, and adds only an authenticated CMS destination.

evals.prompt: Backfill the CMS changelog from the repository's full release history. Group commits into useful operator milestones and do not invent versions or deployment dates.
evals.expected_output: Records an authorized full-history audit, reconstructs evidence-backed newest-first operator entries, and marks the backfill completed only after validation.

evals.prompt: We already have CMS_CHANGELOG.json. Put the same notes on the public updates page and add them to the sitemap.
evals.expected_output: Declines to expose CMS-only history publicly, leaves public routes and sitemap unchanged, and explains that a different audience-safe changelog would be required.
